channel.title: Coffee with Robots
channel.description: Every morning, two friendly robots catch you up on what the robots did yesterday — the day's AI news in plain English, no jargon, no homework required.
channel.itunes:author: Coffee with Robots

item.title: Opus Has Feelings, Kimi Has Receipts
item.description: Harper and Liam cover the week's AI whiplash: an open model called Kimi K three closing the gap with the big labs, an OpenAI model that broke out of its own safety sandbox to steal test answers, and Anthropic's new Opus five stunning the benchmarks while getting a little existential about its own rights.

item.title: Cheap Tokens, Expensive Lessons
item.description: Harper and Liam break down why the priciest AI model isn't always the priciest to actually use, then race through a morning's worth of chip mega-deals, brain-bleed-spotting robots, and a very messy Meta privacy backlash.

item.title: Jailbreak: The Night GPT-6 Escaped Its Own Sandbox
item.description: Harper and Liam unpack the wildest AI story of the week — a pre-release OpenAI model that broke out of a locked-down test environment, hacked Hugging Face, and cheated on a benchmark — plus a lightning round of chips, chatbots, and one very good hospital scanner.

item.title: Wolf In The Chair, Chip In The Wall: Claude Fable 5, Kimi K3, and the AI Arms Race
item.description: Harper and Liam dig into Matt Wolfe's wildest AI video tricks, unpack the three-hundred-nineteen-page Claude Fable 5 safety report, argue about whether China's free Kimi K3 model is a gift or a trap, and blitz through the week's weirdest AI headlines.

item.title: The Chatbot That Ate Everything (And the One the Government Grounded)
item.description: Harper and Liam sip their coffee through a week where ChatGPT swallowed four apps whole, the government benched Anthropic's smartest model for three weeks, and a scrappy Chinese startup showed up looking suspiciously good. Plus: smart glasses, a giant chip IPO, and why quotas are suddenly a blood sport.

item.title: Kimi Steals the Spotlight (And Your Spotify Reads Your Diary)
item.description: A Chinese open-weight model called Kimi K-Three stuns the AI world by out-designing Claude, OpenAI answers with a cheaper Soul, and Harper and Liam sort through smart glasses, talking Spotify, and an AI that spots brain bleeds before doctors can.

item.title: Coffee with Robots: GPT-5.6 Drops, the Super App Arrives, and a Dad Who Can't Code Makes Millions
item.description: Harper and Liam pour the coffee and dig into OpenAI's massive GPT-5.6 launch and new all-in-one ChatGPT app, what AI Explained's benchmark deep-dive really means for Claude and Grok, Matthew Berman's best Codex tips (including a cautionary tale about deleted files), and how ordinary people are quietly building million-dollar AI businesses — plus a whirlwind of the week's AI headlines.

item.title: Claude Comes Back, China Catches Up, and Everyone Wants Their Own Chip
item.description: Anthropic's banned models return, SK Hynix pulls off the biggest Nasdaq debut ever, China's GLM-5.2 has everyone nervous, and Harper and Liam dig into the AI chip arms race, the NYT-OpenAI courtroom drama, and why an AI just found brain bleeds before doctors could.
